item.title: Valero Shuts Major Refinery After Explosion as Fuel Markets Tighten | OilPrice.com
item.description: An explosion at Valero’s Port Arthur refinery has shut down a key U.S. fuel facility, intensifying supply concerns and adding upward pressure to already rising diesel and gasoline prices.

item.title: Indian Refiners Cautious Over Iranian Oil Despite U.S. Waivers | OilPrice.com
item.description: Indian state refiners are hesitant to purchase unsanctioned Iranian crude despite a temporary US waiver, citing concerns over shipping, insurance, and payment uncertainties, while simultaneously increasing imports of Russian crude.

item.title: UAE: Weaponizing Hormuz is Economic Terrorism Against the World | OilPrice.com
item.description: The United Arab Emirates asserts that Iran's weaponization of the Strait of Hormuz is an act of economic terrorism against the world, causing immediate and severe global energy price shocks.

item.title: Outage in Australia Adds to Global LNG Crunch | OilPrice.com
item.description: The temporary shutdown of the Santos-operated Barossa and Darwin LNG plants in Australia is compounding an already severe global LNG supply crunch caused by war and major infrastructure damage in the Middle East.

item.title: China Warns of “Uncontrollable” Escalation as Hormuz Crisis Deepens | OilPrice.com
item.description: China is navigating a delicate balance between diplomacy and energy security as the escalating Strait of Hormuz crisis threatens global oil flows and regional stability.

item.title: India Targets Import Cuts With Historic Oil and Gas Drilling Campaign | OilPrice.com
item.description: India’s ONGC is planning a massive $18–20 billion drilling campaign to boost domestic oil and gas production and reduce reliance on imports amid rising global energy uncertainties.

item.title: India Pushes Back Flexible Coal Power Plan Amid Cost Uncertainty | OilPrice.com
item.description: India has postponed a plan to reduce coal plant output during peak solar generation due to unresolved compensation, safety, and grid stability concerns.

item.title: Naphtha Shortage Forces Japanese Petrochemical Producers to Curb Output | OilPrice.com
item.description: Executives from Japan’s largest gas providers warn that industrial natural gas use may drop due to petrochemical plants curbing output because of Middle East supply constraints on naphtha, even though Japan’s LNG imports are largely secure.

item.title: Germany and South Korea Face Rare Earths Supply Shortage | OilPrice.com
item.description: Germany, the EU, and South Korea face a deficit of rare earth elements critical for defense and automotive industries while the U.S. and Japan secure supply deals following China's export restrictions.

item.title: U.S. Waivers Spur Russian Oil Sales But Interest in Iran’s Crude Remains Low | OilPrice.com
item.description: The US waivers intended to boost oil supply have led to high demand for Russian crude from Asian refiners, especially in India, but firms remain reluctant to purchase Iranian crude due to ongoing uncertainties over shipping, payments, and long-term sanctions risk.

item.title: Will the Iran War Revive Russia’s Power of Siberia 2 Pipeline? | OilPrice.com
item.description: China may revive talks on the Power of Siberia-2 pipeline as war in Iran exposes its energy vulnerabilities.

item.title: Japan Urges IEA to Prepare for Second Emergency Oil Release | OilPrice.com
item.description: Japan's Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi asked the head of the International Energy Agency to prepare for an additional coordinated release of oil stocks should the worsening global supply crisis require it.

item.title: US Oil Inventories Continue to Climb While Gasoline Inventories Shrink | OilPrice.com
item.description: Crude oil inventories in the United States increased by 6.9 million barrels during the week ending March 20, according to new data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) released on Wednesday

item.title: Russia
item.description: A large-scale Ukrainian drone attack hit the Ust-Luga oil port, marking the second strike this week on a critical Baltic Sea export hub, which is contributing to global oil supply concerns and market volatility.

item.title: Crude Drops 4% on Iran News Just as Dallas Fed Signals Oil Rebound | OilPrice.com
item.description: Oil prices fell sharply and US stock markets rose on news of a potential Iran peace plan proposed by President Trump, even as the Dallas Fed reported a major rebound in US oilfield activity and Iranian officials rejected the proposal.
